summary: StratCap Digital Infrastructure REIT filed an 8-K reporting the abrupt resignation of Chairman, director, and President James A. Condon on July 31, 2026, effective immediately. No disagreement was cited. The Board appointed Adam Baxter, then Secretary and director, as Chairman and President on August 3, 2026. Condon also resigned as President of the Sponsor and Advisor, and Baxter succeeded him in those roles. The filing includes Baxter's background but no compensation details. This is a sudden leadership transition, though not disclosed as forced; the stated reason is non-disagreement. Watch for strategic shifts at the REIT and its advisor under new leadership.
